scenes.visualIntent: Replace the myth of a thinking computer with a simple field of examples that reveals a visible pattern.
scenes.compositionIntent: Center one friendly computer card; move cyan example dots into an emerging curved rule while a small human-thought symbol fades away.
scenes.motionIntent: Use frame-driven dot arrivals and a drawn path that becomes stable only after enough examples appear.
scenes.soundIntent: No Scene-local sound is required; narration remains the only audio authority.
scenes.continuityBrief: Introduce the cyan data dots and hand the newly discovered path to the comparison Scene.

scenes.visualIntent: Contrast explicit human-written rules with learning a rule from labeled examples.
scenes.compositionIntent: Use a clean two-lane comparison: the upper lane receives a rule card first, while the lower lane receives example and answer cards first.
scenes.motionIntent: Reveal the traditional lane in one direct pass, then animate the learning lane as examples circulate and condense into a rule card.
scenes.soundIntent: No Scene-local sound is required; narration remains the only audio authority.
scenes.continuityBrief: Inherit the cyan data dots and transform the lower lane into the cat-example workspace.

scenes.visualIntent: Make labeled training examples and learned visual features tangible through a playful cat-classification board.
scenes.compositionIntent: Center a large simple cat icon surrounded by small labeled cat and non-cat cards; isolate ear, outline, and texture marks one at a time.
scenes.motionIntent: Feed cards toward the center, then draw three feature callouts with gentle spring emphasis as the shared pattern strengthens.
scenes.soundIntent: No Scene-local sound is required; narration remains the only audio authority.
scenes.continuityBrief: Preserve the cyan examples and carry the extracted feature marks into the training loop.

scenes.visualIntent: Connect training, parameter adjustment, model formation, and prediction as one causal loop.
scenes.compositionIntent: Build a central lime model node surrounded by a coral error loop and three adjustable parameter knobs, then introduce one new image card for prediction.
scenes.motionIntent: Cycle examples through the loop, reduce the error marker over time, lock the model node, and reveal a clear prediction meter for the new card.
scenes.soundIntent: No Scene-local sound is required; narration remains the only audio authority.
scenes.continuityBrief: Carry the completed lime model node forward, but keep its output provisional for the limits Scene.

scenes.visualIntent: Show that a model follows its training data and can reproduce an imbalance rather than understand the world.
scenes.compositionIntent: Place a visibly imbalanced stack of training cards on the left, the same lime model in the center, and a skewed prediction scale with a coral warning on the right.
scenes.motionIntent: Feed the uneven data through the model, tilt the output scale, then reveal three large safeguards: good data, clear goal, and continuous checks.
scenes.soundIntent: No Scene-local sound is required; narration remains the only audio authority.
scenes.continuityBrief: Resolve the coral warning by carrying the safeguarded model into the final full pipeline.

scenes.visualIntent: Close with a single memorable definition assembled from the visual concepts already introduced.
scenes.compositionIntent: Use one vertical pathway of four large nodes: data, training, model, and prediction, with the same cyan, coral, lime, and ivory identities.
scenes.motionIntent: Assemble the four nodes in narration order, send one new input through the completed pathway, and hold on the resulting prediction.
scenes.soundIntent: No Scene-local sound is required; narration remains the only audio authority.
scenes.continuityBrief: Complete the progressive pathway and end on a stable high-contrast summary frame.
